dogecoin.text: When you to go the gym and start hearing everyone talking about #dogecoin and #cryptocurrency between sets, it is hard to say there isn't a bubble.

When you hear a dad talking about how he is matching every dollar his teenage son puts into #dogecoin (and this kid was pumping the majority of his income into it), Charlie Munger's comments on #cryptocurrency being dangerous and immoral start to make a lot of sense.
